attributes.title: 2027 LAMFT Annual Conference
attributes.organizer: Louisiana Association for Marriage and Family Therapy
attributes.summary:
LAMFT says the 2027 meeting will lean on connection within the state's MFT community, so expect networking to get real time alongside education. It is a useful stop for Louisiana clinicians who want to meet supervisors and colleagues in one place.

Speakers, sessions, fees and CE hours are not published yet. The association runs its own CEU program, and its past conferences offered roughly 18 to 20 hours, but treat that as history until the 2027 number appears. The site's heading still says 2026 while the date line reads April 15 to 17, 2027.
